Every spoken line, quick-question prompt and response, romantic wish, frog-care instruction, joke, family memory, and belonging statement was reviewed in full event context. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, quick-question break branches, item and quest conditions, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. This completes the Mountain event asset; full-locale final audits remain pending.
